h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panaji

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Panaji

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panaji

c: Panaji sits on the Mandovi estuary, and its promenade, Campal gardens and Miramar beachfront are where the city goes for an evening walk. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Panaji for the city corporation, schools, colleges, housing societies and hotels. Our factory in Vasai is about 440 km away, and we bring the machines to Goa by road.

A dealer from our western India network or our own installers fix them in place. Goa's monsoon is heavy and long, from June to September, and salt air reaches every part of Panaji. Every frame we make is galvanised for this reason, and machines near the river or the beach need a fresh-water rinse every few weeks. We plan installation in the dry months, when grouted footings can set properly.

items.q: Can a hotel in Panaji add an outdoor gym for guests?
items.a: Yes. A garden corner or poolside strip often fits two or three machines. Share the space and photos, and we will suggest machines and mark the clear space on a layout.

items.q: How do we stop machines corroding near the Mandovi or the beach?
items.a: The frames are galvanised. Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks, keep sand off the base and tighten loose bolts during routine checks.

items.q: When is the best time to install in Goa?
items.a: Between October and May. Grouted footings need dry weather to set, so we plan dispatch and installation dates to avoid the monsoon.
